messages:
neal: apiserver 5xx spike in eu-west1, seeing a bunch of upstream etcd EOFs. controller-manager queue depth is climbing fast. started when a big GPU batch attach wave hit the zone ~ 06:22 UTC
ops-bot: [ALERT] apiserver error-rate eu-west1 exceeded threshold (5m avg). Incident created: INC-2026-237. links: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-237 :rotating_light:
aisha: looking at etcd metrics now — disk i/o iops and fsync latency both spiking. leader flips ~30s. also seeing many short lived apiserver connections (SYN→RST) to nodes in gpu-pool-3
marc: any NAT/egress exhaustion in that VPC? GPU attach process creates a ton of ephemeral connections to provider API which can blow our ephemeral ports
neal: yes marc, net-nat metrics show port exhaustion across the node fleet in eu-west1-a, ephemeral port inuse ~98% for the autoscaled pool
liam: ok two-prong: (1) throttle autoscaler + pause new batch attach jobs, (2) increase NAT IPs / bump SNAT concurrency on the gateway. which do we want first?
sre-oncall: start with throttling autoscaler (quick) — rollback policy to avoid leaving customer jobs blocked. ops: add NAT IPs in parallel (longer but required)
aisha: I can flip autoscaler policy to cap at current desired + 10 for the region and set cooldown to 20m. doing that now: `gcloud compute routers nats update ... --nat-external-ips` queued
marc: while that's in flight, we should reduce apiserver watch fanout. can we temporarily disable non-critical controllers in eu-west1? e.g., ingress controller debug metrics, some non-prod controllers
neal: good call. I'm going to cordon the non-prod controller-manager replicas in eu-west1 and let leader election move critical controllers to other regions.
liam: also bump apiserver replicas from 3→5 for that AZ to spread TCP sockets and reduce per-pod fd pressure. rolling now with `kubectl -n kube-system scale deploy kube-apiserver --replicas=5` — doing a canary subset first
aisha: NAT IP increase finished (added 4 IPs) — monitoring ephemeral port usage :eyes:
ops-bot: Automation: autoscaler paused for gpu-pool-3 by aisha. Message: 'pause due to controlplane instability'
sre-oncall: good containment. still seeing leader flips but IO latency dropping from 80ms→20ms after throttling attach traffic. controller queue depth stabilizing slowly
eal: logs show fewer `etcdserver: request timed out` and apiserver 503s dropping. keep watch for 10m
marc: postmortem action items: add provider-side rate limit for attach API, increase NAT pool for gpu zones, add a guard in autoscaler to detect ephem-port exhaustion and backoff, and surface attach operation metrics to alerting
liam: i'll create the deploy to add ephemeral-port guard in autoscaler tomorrow. will also add a quick dashboard for nat/ephemeral usage per-zone
aisha: follow-up: schedule a controlled reattach test after 1h to validate no regression
sre-oncall: moving incident to monitoring state, will update INC-2026-237 with timeline and RCA draft. thanks team :thumbsup:
